name: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C). 2. Roll out dough into a circle. 3. Spread crushed tomatoes evenly. 4. Add torn mozzarella. 5. Drizzle olive oil, season with salt and pepper. 6. Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden. 7. Top with fresh basil before serving.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the spices for 30 min. 2. Grill chicken until charred. 3. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. 4. Add tomato paste and remaining spices. 5. Pour in coconut cream, simmer 10 min. 6. Add grilled chicken, cook 15 min. 7. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with rice or naan.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
instructions: 1. Toast bread until golden. 2. Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, pepper. 3. Bring water to simmer, add vinegar. 4. Crack eggs into water, poach 3-4 min. 5. Spread avocado on toast. 6. Top with poached egg. 7. Sprinkle red pepper flakes.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa
instructions: 1. Brown ground beef with onion. 2. Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water, simmer 5 min. 3. Warm taco shells. 4. Fill shells with beef. 5. Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese. 6. Add sour cream and lime juice.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: 1. Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion in a bowl. 2. Add olives and crumbled feta. 3. Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, pepper. 4. Pour dressing over salad. 5. Toss gently and serve immediately.

name: Pad Thai
instructions: 1. Soak noodles in warm water 30 min. 2. Mix fish sauce, tamarind, sugar. 3. Stir-fry garlic and protein. 4. Push aside, scramble eggs. 5. Add drained noodles and sauce. 6. Toss until coated. 7. Add bean sprouts. 8. Serve with peanuts, lime, green onions.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Cream butter and sugars. 3. Beat in eggs and vanilla. 4. Mix flour, baking soda, salt separately. 5. Combine wet and dry ingredients. 6. Fold in chocolate chips. 7. Drop spoonfuls on baking sheet. 8. Bake 10-12 min until golden.

name: Caesar Salad
instructions: 1. Chop romaine into bite-sized pieces. 2. Mash garlic and anchovies into paste. 3. Whisk in egg yolk, mustard, lemon juice. 4. Slowly drizzle olive oil while whisking. 5. Toss lettuce with dressing. 6. Top with parmesan and croutons. 7. Add black pepper.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: 1. Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water. 2. Fry pancetta until crispy. 3. Whisk egg yolks with parmesan and black pepper. 4. Drain pasta, reserve 1 cup pasta water. 5. Toss hot pasta with pancetta. 6. Remove from heat, quickly mix in egg mixture. 7. Add pasta water to reach creamy consistency. 8. Serve immediately with extra parmesan.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: 1. Heat sesame oil in wok over high heat. 2. Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 seconds. 3. Add broccoli and carrot, cook 3 min. 4. Add bell pepper and snap peas, cook 2 min. 5. Mix soy sauce with cornstarch and 2 tbsp water. 6. Pour over vegetables, toss until glossy. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds. Serve over rice.

name: French Onion Soup
instructions: 1. Melt butter in large pot. 2. Add onions, cook 45 min until caramelized, stirring often. 3. Add wine, scrape bottom. 4. Pour in broth, add bay leaves and thyme. 5. Simmer 20 min. 6. Toast baguette slices. 7. Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls. 8. Top with bread and cheese. 9. Broil until cheese is bubbly and golden.

name: Banana Pancakes
instructions: 1. Mash bananas in a bowl. 2. Beat in eggs. 3. Add flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt. 4. Mix until just combined. 5. Heat butter in pan over medium heat. 6. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. 7. Cook until bubbles form, flip. 8. Cook 2 more minutes. 9. Serve with syrup and berries.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: 1. Heat oil in wok, scramble eggs, set aside. 2. Cook chicken until done, set aside. 3. Stir-fry garlic and vegetables 3 min. 4. Add cold rice, break up clumps. 5. Add soy sauce and oyster sauce. 6. Return chicken and eggs. 7. Toss everything together. 8. Garnish with green onions and sesame oil.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: 1. Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into 1/4 inch rounds. 2. Arrange alternating slices on a platter. 3. Tuck basil leaves between slices. 4. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze. 5. Sprinkle with sea salt and black pepper. 6. Let sit 10 min before serving.

name: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: 1. Cook egg noodles according to package. 2. Brown beef in butter, set aside. 3. Sauté onion and mushrooms. 4. Add garlic, cook 1 min. 5. Sprinkle flour, stir. 6. Pour in broth, simmer until thickened. 7. Return beef, cook 5 min. 8. Remove from heat, stir in sour cream. 9. Serve over noodles with parsley.

name: Guacamole
instructions: 1. Halve avocados, remove pits. 2. Scoop flesh into bowl. 3. Mash with fork to desired consistency. 4. Add lime juice immediately. 5. Fold in tomato, onion, cilantro, jalapeño, garlic. 6. Season with salt and pepper. 7. Serve with tortilla chips.

name: Lemon Garlic Salmon
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Place salmon on baking sheet. 3. Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, dill. 4. Pour over salmon. 5. Season with salt and pepper. 6. Add asparagus around salmon. 7. Bake 12-15 min until salmon flakes easily. 8. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Minestrone Soup
instructions: 1. Sauté onion, carrot, celery in olive oil. 2. Add garlic, cook 1 min. 3. Pour in tomatoes and broth. 4. Add Italian herbs, simmer 20 min. 5. Add beans and pasta, cook 10 min. 6. Stir in spinach until wilted. 7. Season with salt and pepper. 8. Serve with parmesan.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
instructions: 1. Mix brown sugar, paprika, cumin, salt, pepper. 2. Rub all over pork. 3. Place onion and garlic in slow cooker. 4. Add pork on top. 5. Pour 1 cup BBQ sauce over. 6. Cook on low 8 hours. 7. Shred pork with forks. 8. Mix with remaining BBQ sauce. 9. Serve on buns with coleslaw.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: 1. Sauté onion and bell pepper until soft. 2. Add garlic, cumin, paprika. 3. Pour in crushed tomatoes, simmer 15 min. 4. Make 6 wells in sauce. 5. Crack an egg into each well. 6. Cover and cook until eggs are set. 7. Sprinkle with parsley and feta. 8. Serve with pita bread.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: 1. Bring broth to boil with chicken. 2. Reduce heat, simmer 20 min. 3. Remove chicken, shred. 4. Sauté onion, carrot, celery in pot. 5. Add garlic, cook 1 min. 6. Return broth and chicken. 7. Add noodles, thyme, bay leaves. 8. Cook 10 min until noodles tender. 9. Season and serve.

name: Vegetable Curry
instructions: 1. Sauté onion until soft. 2. Add garlic and curry powder, cook 1 min. 3. Add potatoes and carrots, cook 5 min. 4. Pour in tomatoes and coconut milk. 5. Add cauliflower and chickpeas. 6. Simmer 25 min until vegetables tender. 7. Garnish with cilantro. 8. Serve with rice or naan.

name: Tiramisu
instructions: 1. Whisk egg yolks and sugar until thick. 2. Fold in mascarpone until smooth. 3. Mix coffee with liqueur. 4. Quickly dip ladyfingers in coffee mixture. 5. Layer half in dish. 6. Spread half mascarpone mixture. 7. Repeat layers. 8. Dust with cocoa powder. 9. Refrigerate 4 hours. 10. Top with chocolate shavings before serving.

name: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
instructions: 1. Roast sweet potato and chickpeas with olive oil at 400°F for 25 min. 2. Massage kale with olive oil and salt. 3. Cook quinoa according to package. 4. Make dressing: blend tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water until smooth. 5. Assemble bowls: quinoa base, add kale, sweet potato, chickpeas, avocado. 6. Drizzle with tahini dressing.

name: Apple Pie
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). 2. Mix apples, sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg. 3. Line pie dish with one crust. 4. Fill with apple mixture. 5. Dot with butter. 6. Cover with second crust, seal edges. 7. Cut slits in top. 8. Brush with beaten egg. 9. Bake 45-50 min until golden. 10. Cool before slicing. Serve with ice cream.
